troops.name: Barch Squad
troops.info: Battle called. They answered.\n\nFifteen Barbarians. Fifteen Archers. Battle cries at charge with sniper support from the rear. It shouldn’t work, but it does, like a beautiful symphony of destruction.

troops.name: Giant Wizard Squad
troops.info: Giants aren’t patient, and Wizards are famed for their fashionable lateness. For this Squad, punctuality isn’t a priority, but destruction sure is!\n\nThe big guys get to a smashing start while the brainy guys burn it all to the ground!

troops.name: Wall Breaker Squad
troops.info: A demolition Squad of five Wall Breakers who never take lunch breaks. The newbie is keen to impress and rushes first to trigger traps and attention.\n\nYour enemies won’t miss their walls. Open-plan is all the rage.

troops.name: Minion Squad
troops.info: Minions are surprisingly social creatures. These fellows were found in the crevice of a Dark Elixir ravine and are particularly playful in Squads of eight. Wizard studies show that they enter a village-ravishing frenzy when deployed.

troops.name: Balloon Squad
troops.info: These defense-seekers used to live off the generous geysers of Balloon Bay before they enrolled in the Squad Barracks bootcamp. Don’t fret, Skeletons are impervious to homesickness.

troops.name: Golem Witch Squad
troops.info: Stones and sorcery.\n\nNothing gets to the soft gooey center of a Golem faster than a Witch’s love. The rocky guys take charge at first, followed swiftly behind by Witches and their rickety Skeleton rioters.

troops.name: Hog Rider Squad
troops.info: This isn’t a Squad, it’s a stampede!\n\nThe ground trembles as the fierce leaping Hogs approach. Walls are a joke, so are defenses, and so is anyone who stands in their way. In truth, these guys have been squadding up for years.

troops.name: Miner Squad
troops.info: Ten shovels. Ten tunnels. Ten surprises for your enemy!\n\nBonded by their long, sweltering stint in volcanic Gem caverns, walls remain no issue for these rogue terrain terrors who network in the deep to spring a synced attack!

troops.name: Healer Squad
troops.info: It's a foolproof strategy.\n\nA Balloon swoops first to rouse traps, leaving the skies easy and breezy for Healers to do their thing: Heal other units, obviously.

troops.name: P.E.K.K.A Titan Squad
troops.info: P.E.K.K.A doesn’t talk much, Electro Titan likes that.\n\nThe way this Squad duo crushes buildings is like music to the ear: Thunk, Zap, Thud, Buzz. Too bad their shock aura eviscerates everyone in earshot.

troops.name: Dragons Squad
troops.info: This Squad is all burn, no bite.\n\nScorched villages are on the menu, and these beastly sky-dwellers are serving a dangerous double course: Dragons drop a spicy main dish, and if your enemy is still famished, Dragon Riders whirr up a dessert that’s harsh on the tongue and hard to swallow.

troops.name: Baby Dragon Squad
troops.info: There’s a heavy bounty for the one who finds The Tantrum Triplets.\n\nThey barely had their flying wings beneath them when they busted out of Dragon Momma’s daycare. After their first upgrade, the trio will tantrum in the company of their own Squad, but get shy around others.
